그.forms: 그 + noun: 그 사람 · 그 영화 · 그것 (that thing) · 거기 (there)
그.m: that (near the listener, or already mentioned); the
그.x: Have you seen that movie? It's really good.
그.e: Also builds 그것 (that) and 거기 (there); in writing 그 can mean 'he'.

이야기.x: I talked with my friend for a long time.
이야기.t: In speech it's often shortened to 얘기: 얘기해요.

일하다.e: Native 일 (work) + 하다 (do). Different from 일 'day' and 일 'one'.
일하다.t: Pronounced [일하다] (the ㅎ is kept in standard pronunciation). Place of work takes 에서: 회사에서 일해요.

느리다.x: The internet at our house is too slow.
느리다.e: Opposite of 빠르다. For 'slowly' Koreans usually say 천천히.

늦다.t: Also works as a verb 'to be late for': 학교에 늦었어요 = I was late for school.

설거지하다.m: to do the dishes, to wash up
설거지하다.x: My younger sibling does the dishes every evening.
설거지하다.t: You can also say 설거지를 하다 with the object particle; both are equally common.

더러워지다.ex: 어제 비가 와서 새 신발이 더러워졌어요.
더러워지다.x: It rained yesterday, so my new shoes got dirty.
더러워지다.e: 더럽다 (dirty) + -어지다 (to become); the ㅂ changes to 워.
더러워지다.t: -아/어지다 turns adjectives into 'become' verbs: 깨끗해지다, 추워지다.

음료수.x: It was hot, so I bought a cold drink at the convenience store.
음료수.t: Pronounced [음뇨수] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅁ.

나누다.m: to share; to divide, to split; to exchange (words, greetings)
나누다.x: I split the pizza in half with my friend and ate it.
나누다.e: Core idea is 'split into parts' — sharing food, dividing numbers, exchanging talk.
나누다.t: Common collocations: 이야기를 나누다 (chat), 인사를 나누다 (exchange greetings), 음식을 나누다 (share food).

반드시.ex: 이 약은 반드시 식사 후에 드세요.
반드시.x: Be sure to take this medicine after meals.
반드시.e: Sounds like 반듯이 'straight, neatly' — different spelling and meaning.

살을 빼다.forms: 살을 빼요 · 살을 뺐어요; 살이 빠지다 = to lose weight (it just happens)
살을 빼다.ex: 여름이 오기 전에 살을 빼려고 매일 운동해요.
살을 빼다.x: I'm working out every day to lose weight before summer.
살을 빼다.e: 살 'flesh' plus 빼다 'to take out' — literally 'take the flesh off.'
살을 빼다.t: Use 살을 빼다 for deliberate effort and 살이 빠지다 when weight drops on its own.

독특하다.x: This cafe's interior is really unique.
독특하다.t: It can be a compliment (unique) or slightly negative (odd), depending on tone.

높아지다.m: to become higher, to rise, to increase
높아지다.x: When summer comes, the temperature rises a lot.
높아지다.t: Pronounced [노파지다]: the final ㅍ of 높 carries over to the next syllable.

혼나다.m: to get scolded, to get in trouble; to have a hard time
혼나다.x: I got scolded by the teacher for not doing my homework.
혼나다.e: Probably 혼 (soul) + 나다 (go out) — so scared your soul leaves you.
혼나다.t: The person scolding takes 한테 or 께: 엄마한테 혼났어요. The active form is 혼내다.

멈추다.m: to stop, to halt, to come to a stop
멈추다.x: Suddenly the bus stopped in the middle of the road.
멈추다.e: The noun 멈춤 'stop' appears on signs and video players.

역사적.x: Today is a historic day for our team.

오디션.ex: 가수가 되고 싶어서 기획사 오디션을 봤어요.
오디션.x: I wanted to become a singer, so I auditioned for an agency.
오디션.t: The verb is 보다: 오디션을 보다 'to audition'. To pass is 오디션에 붙다 or 합격하다.

국악.ex: 외국인 친구와 함께 국악 공연을 보러 갔어요.
국악.x: I went to see a traditional Korean music performance with a foreign friend.

배려심.ex: 그 친구는 배려심이 깊어서 인기가 많아요.
배려심.x: That friend is very considerate, so she's popular.
배려심.e: -심 = a heart or mind for something: 배려심, 이해심, 자부심.
배려심.t: 배려심이 깊다 or 배려심이 있다 'considerate' is a very common compliment.

슬며시.forms: 슬며시 + verb: 슬며시 웃다, 슬며시 손을 잡다
슬며시.x: The child quietly took her mom's hand.
슬며시.t: Often softer than 몰래: it describes gentle, unnoticed action, not necessarily sneaky or wrong.

성장하다.ex: 우리 회사는 지난 5년 동안 빠르게 성장했어요.
성장하다.x: Our company has grown fast over the past five years.

건지다.m: to take out (of liquid), to scoop up; to rescue; to salvage
건지다.x: I scooped the green onions out of the soup.
건지다.t: Casual: 사진 한 장 건졌다 means you got at least one good photo out of it.

반지하.x: Semi-basement units have cheap rent, but they're very damp.

강대국.ex: 작은 나라들은 강대국 사이에서 균형을 잡으려고 노력합니다.
강대국.x: Small countries try to keep a balance between the great powers.

급증하다.e: Literally 'sudden increase'; 급- = sharply: 급증, 급감, 급등, 급락.

융합하다.m: to fuse, to merge, to converge
융합하다.ex: 여러 학문을 융합해서 새로운 분야를 만들었습니다.
융합하다.x: They fused several disciplines to create a new field.

부질없이.ex: 이미 끝난 일인데 부질없이 걱정만 했어요.
부질없이.x: It was already over, but I just worried for nothing.
부질없이.t: Pronounced [부지럽씨]; 부질없는 짓 means 'a pointless thing to do'.

걸음마를 떼다.forms: 걸음마를 떼요 · 뗐어요 · 뗄 거예요; often 이제 막 걸음마를 뗀 + noun
걸음마를 떼다.m: to take one's first steps; to be just getting started (at something)
걸음마를 떼다.ex: 우리 회사의 인공지능 사업은 이제 막 걸음마를 뗐어요.
걸음마를 떼다.x: Our company's AI business has only just taken its first steps.
걸음마를 떼다.e: 걸음마 = a baby's first steps, built from 걸음 'step' (from 걷다 'to walk').
걸음마를 떼다.t: Used literally for babies and figuratively for new projects, industries or skills still in their infancy.

언론 자유.m: freedom of the press, freedom of speech
언론 자유.x: Freedom of the press is the foundation of democracy.
언론 자유.e: 언론 = 'speech and discussion', now meaning the press or media.
언론 자유.t: Pronounced [얼론 자유] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

간에 기별도 안 가다.forms: 간에 기별도 안 가요 · 간에 기별도 안 갈 (+noun)
간에 기별도 안 가다.m: to be far too little food to fill one up, to barely take the edge off one's hunger (lit. not even word of it reaches the liver)
간에 기별도 안 가다.ex: 샐러드 한 접시로는 간에 기별도 안 가요.
간에 기별도 안 가다.x: One plate of salad doesn't even begin to fill me up.
간에 기별도 안 가다.e: 기별 means 'news, notice': the food is so little that not even news of it reaches the liver.
간에 기별도 안 가다.t: Casual and humorous, about small portions: 이 정도로는 간에 기별도 안 가요.

과거사.m: past history (especially painful or unresolved past events)
과거사.ex: 두 나라는 과거사 문제로 오랫동안 갈등을 겪어 왔어요.
과거사.x: The two countries have long been in conflict over issues of their past history.
과거사.t: In politics it usually means unresolved historical wrongs, as in 과거사 청산 or 과거사 반성.

관념론.ex: 관념론은 정신이나 관념을 세계의 근본으로 봅니다.
관념론.x: Idealism sees the mind or ideas as the foundation of the world.
관념론.t: Pronounced [관념논]; for idealism meaning 'high ideals', use 이상주의.

강박관념.ex: 완벽해야 한다는 강박관념 때문에 늘 피곤해요.
강박관념.x: I'm always tired because of my obsession with being perfect.
강박관념.e: Literally 'a thought that forces and presses on you'.

상징주의.ex: 상징주의 시는 의미를 직접 말하지 않고 암시합니다.
상징주의.x: Symbolist poetry hints at meaning rather than stating it directly.

갑오개혁.x: The Gabo Reform, carried out in 1894, abolished the class system and the state examinations.
갑오개혁.e: Named after 1894, a gabo year in the 60-year cycle.
갑오개혁.t: Many events carry their cycle-year names: 임진 (1592), 갑오 (1894), 을사 (1905).

당랑거철.m: a hopeless fight against a far stronger opponent
당랑거철.ex: 작은 가게가 대기업과 경쟁하는 건 당랑거철 같아요.
당랑거철.x: A small shop competing with a big corporation is like a mantis facing a chariot.
당랑거철.e: Literally 'a praying mantis trying to block a chariot wheel'.
당랑거철.t: Pronounced [당낭거철] — the ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

에너지효율.x: A refrigerator with a first-grade energy efficiency rating uses less electricity.
에너지효율.t: Korean appliances carry 에너지소비효율 등급 labels from grade 1 (best) to 5.

다기망양.m: losing the truth among too many paths; getting lost in too many options
다기망양.ex: 전공을 너무 많이 바꾸다 보니 다기망양이 되고 말았어요.
다기망양.x: Switching majors so often, I ended up lost among too many paths.
다기망양.e: A lost sheep couldn't be found because the road kept forking.
